reason: A web-interface desktop-pet plugin that visualizes DeepSeek Harness agent activity, approvals, progress, completion, and failures through an interactive animated whale companion.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可交互的像素鲸鱼桌宠，用动画、音效和提示反映智能体活动及审批状态。
summaries.en: An interactive pixel-art whale companion for the DeepSeek Harness web interface that reflects agent activity and approval states with animations, sounds, and notifications.

capabilities: Reads persistent agent session events to derive task status
Displays an animated pixel-art companion in the web interface
Shows approval and task notifications through visual effects and browser tab title changes
Provides local interaction controls, position persistence, sounds, and pet customization
Exposes local plugin endpoints for state, interaction, assets, and optional preview control
Registers a whale_say agent tool for speech and animations
